summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed an 8-K to furnish a press release announcing Q2 2026 financial results. Revenue of $3.8 million beat consensus of $3.62 million; EPS of $(0.41) beat consensus of $(0.56). Gross margin improved to 29.1% from 6.1% year-over-year. The company highlighted a landmark $54.6 million, 10-year contract and acquisitions of Secuvant and Kustom's video solutions, driving an estimated $30 million revenue run rate. This is a routine earnings release, not a special-situation event. The 8-K is informational, with no M&A, capital markets, or structural changes requiring classification.
